item.title: Dr Nicole Solomon joins Children’s Life Fund board
item.description: DR NICOLE SOLOMON, a consultant paediatric nephrologist at the Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex (EWMSC), has been appointed to the the board of management of the Children’s Life Fund Authority (CLFA). The authority announced her appointment in a news release on January 20. Solomon, the release said, has extensive experience in the development and delivery of specialised paediatric renal services, including dialysis and transplantation. item.title: Financial unit, Inland Revenue agree to share info
item.description: THE Financial Intelligence Unit of TT (FIUTT) and the Inland Revenue Division (IRD) have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) on the exchange of financial intelligence. A statement issued by the Finance Ministry on January 19 said the objective of the MoU is for both departments to collaborate within the provisions of their respective governing acts, and to subsequently share information on their own motion or upon request. item.title: Body found in San Raphael believed to be missing man
item.description: AN autopsy is expected to be done this week at the Forensic Science Centre in St James on the body of a man found on the roadside in San Raphael over the weekend. The victim is believed to be 25-year-old Jamal Rampersad of Lothians Road, Princes Town. He was last seen alive on January 14 at a bar in Curepe with a woman he reportedly met on social media. item.title: PM to consider social media ban for children under 12
item.description: PRIME Minister Kamla Persad-Bissessar and Public Administration and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Minister Dominic Smith share the concerns of Archbishop Charles Jason Gordon about the need to protect children from the dangers of social media. Persad-Bissessar said government may be willing to consider a social media ban for children under 12 years old. item.title: OWTU: A step in the right direction for workers
item.description: THE Oilfields Workers’ Trade Union (OWTU) is backing proposed amendments to the Retrenchment and Severance Benefits Act (RSBA). item.description: A POST on social media on January 17 of a contract sent to parents of the Fyzabad Secondary School outlining what hairstyles are not allowed for female students, using pictures of black women, has ignited another controversy about racism in schools.
